description: OlympiadMAS — primary multi-agent session tracks (34 = index.json core 12 + fork promotions); auxiliary question corpora → index_aux.json
note_on_30: Collect one full published team task per slot (internal sub-parts stay together). Combine across years/contests to reach 30 where history allows; some olympiads have fewer than 30 available.

olympiads.name: International Junior Science Olympiad — Practical (Team)

gold_scores.notes: Marking schemes in answer PDFs. Gold practical team = top /40.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One full team practical per IJSO year; ~30 editions since 2004

olympiads.name: International Economics Olympiad — Business Case

gold_scores.notes: 2025 winner Canada 92.5/100 overall raw. https://2025.ieo-official.org/results

olympiads.collection_strategy: One full business case per IEO year (2021–2025 available so far)

olympiads.name: International Linguistics Olympiad — Team Contest

gold_scores.notes: Solutions PDF per year. Human gold e.g. 200.0/200 (2025 Taiwan).

olympiads.collection_strategy: One full team contest per year; 2003–2025

olympiads.name: International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics — Group Competition

gold_scores.notes: Marking schemes in solution PDFs. Winner = fastest team.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One full group competition per IOAA edition (2007–2024)

olympiads.name: ARML Power Contest

gold_scores.notes: Solution PDFs published each season. Top teams 36–40/40.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One full power round per contest season (~2/year since 1994)

olympiads.name: ARML National Meet — Team Round

gold_scores.notes: Solution sections in national meet PDFs and 2009–2014 book.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One team round per national meet year

olympiads.name: ARML National Meet — Power Round

gold_scores.notes: Solution sections in national meet PDFs and 2009–2014 book.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One power round per national meet year

olympiads.name: ARML Local

gold_scores.notes: Team solutions in 2009–2014 book.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One local team round per year from ARML book

olympiads.name: World Scholar's Cup — Collaborative Writing

gold_scores.notes: Published essay prompts and rubrics per annual season. Top team scores available from leaderboards.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One collaborative writing portfolio (3 essays on shared theme) per annual WSC season

olympiads.name: Philip C. Jessup International Law Moot Court Competition

gold_scores.notes: Compromis (problem) published annually since 1960. Winning memorials available via Jessup Compendium / HeinOnline.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One Compromis per year; agents write memorials arguing both Applicant and Respondent sides

olympiads.name: International Informatics Olympiad in Teams (IIOT)

gold_scores.notes: Task statements and results published at iio.team/competition/tasks. Scoring based on automated judge (accepted / wrong answer).

olympiads.collection_strategy: One full contest set per IIOT edition (international round); teams of 4 solve algorithmic problems in 3–4 hours

olympiads.name: ICPC — International Collegiate Programming Contest

gold_scores.notes: World Finals problem sets and solutions published since 1976 at problems.icpc.io and icpc.kattis.com.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One World Finals problem set per year; teams of 3 solve algorithmic problems on 1 computer in 5 hours

olympiads.name: CFA Institute Research Challenge

gold_scores.notes: Champion equity reports / presentations used as reference solutions in staging extract.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One equity-research case / champion set per available season

olympiads.name: European Olympiad of Experimental Science (EOES / EUSO)

gold_scores.notes: Lab practical packets; marking schemes not fully digitized — rubric placeholders in gold_label.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One EOES/EUSO practical packet per available year

olympiads.name: APPE Intercollegiate Ethics Bowl

gold_scores.notes: Case sets with ethics-bowl rubric; no single official answer key.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One APPE Ethics Bowl case set per available season

olympiads.name: National High School Ethics Bowl

gold_scores.notes: Case set with NHSEB rubric; expand year coverage.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One NHSEB National Case Set PDF per season from nhseb.org/s/ (official National Case Set archive)

olympiads.name: International Chemistry Tournament (IChTo)

gold_scores.notes: Problem sets published; solutions/marking uneven across years.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One IChTo problem set per available tournament year

olympiads.name: COMAP Math Modeling (HiMCM / MCM / ICM / IM2C / MidMCM)

gold_scores.notes: Official problems + COMAP modeling rubrics; outstanding papers not bulk-included.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One COMAP modeling problem per contest/year slot

olympiads.name: PUMaC Power Round

gold_scores.notes: Power-round packets; solution PDFs linked when present in local archive.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One PUMaC Power Round per year group (+ misc)

olympiads.name: Willem C. Vis International Commercial Arbitration Moot

gold_scores.notes: Problem (Vis moot case) published annually; winning memorials not bundled.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One Vis Moot problem per available year

olympiads.name: Wharton Global High School Investment Competition

gold_scores.notes: Investment briefs with rubric; expand seasons.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One Wharton Investment Competition brief per available season

olympiads.name: National Collegiate Cyber Defense Competition (NCCDC)

gold_scores.notes: Team Packet scenario briefs; live injects/VMs not included. Some PDFs are image-only stubs.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One nationals Team Packet (or support doc) per available year in local archive

olympiads.name: DebateBench (WUDC / BP)

gold_scores.notes: Cleaned BP debate transcripts with debate rubrics; no single gold speech.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One cleaned debate transcript per staging record

olympiads.name: Global Case Competition at Harvard

gold_scores.notes: Official cases + some winning team papers in local archive.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One GCCH case / paper packet per available year

olympiads.name: International History Olympiad / IHBB — History Bowl

gold_scores.notes: Answers from packet ANSWER lines when present. Includes open IHBB Asia Varsity/JV Bowl PDFs.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One History Bowl round/session per open Bowl PDF (IHO + IHBB Asia Varsity/JV; Bee / Middle School excluded)

olympiads.name: NCF-Envirothon

gold_scores.notes: Current Issue study guides + OP rules; no answer keys published.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One Current Issue session (Part A/B + OP rules) per year from envirothon.org

olympiads.name: International Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence — Team Challenge

gold_scores.notes: 2024 Practical has published best-solution ZIP; 2025 scoring task-specific.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One Team Challenge / Practical Round packet per available year

olympiads.name: Science Olympiad (USA)

gold_scores.notes: Only free soinc.org sample packets mirrored; rules manuals membership-locked.

olympiads.collection_strategy: Free official sample exams / logistics until licensed Rules Manuals available

olympiads.name: World Robot Olympiad

gold_scores.notes: Official Games & Rules PDFs; no single numeric gold key.

olympiads.collection_strategy: Future Innovators Mission + RoboMission age-group game rules per season

olympiads.name: Odyssey of the Mind

gold_scores.notes: Public synopses only; full scoring packets membership-locked.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One year of public Long-Term Problem synopses per session

olympiads.name: World Mathematics Team Championship

gold_scores.notes: Team Round solutions cropped from official solutions PDFs. Individual/Relay ignored for MultiAgentBench.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One year×level Team Round session; Individual/Relay text stripped from bundled PDFs
olympiads.note: Team-section-only extract from mixed publisher PDFs

olympiads.name: Physics Brawl Online (Fyziklání)

gold_scores.notes: 14/14 staging records have expected_answer.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One Physics Brawl Online session per year with problem-only visual assets

olympiads.name: HMMT Guts Round (February and November)

gold_scores.notes: 44 sessions have complete official packets; February 2000 has an official answer sheet with four blank entries.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One complete HMMT Guts Round per season and year

olympiads.name: Purple Comet! Math Meet

gold_scores.notes: 44/44 staging records have expected_answer.

olympiads.collection_strategy: One Purple Comet division session per year with official numeric answer list
